invariants.title: Mutations are serialized through one revision clock
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should advance revision for query-engine mutations

invariants.title: Every query response binds to exactly one snapshotIdUsed
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should pin query results to fixed snapshot state across document changes

invariants.title: Fixed snapshot queries are deterministic
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should return deterministic payload for identical fixed-snapshot queries

invariants.title: Cancelled requests never publish normal result payloads
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should return contract-defined cancellation top-level error code

invariants.title: Unknown fixed snapshots return explicit snapshot-not-found code
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should return contract-defined snapshot-not-found result-envelope code

invariants.title: Protocol handshake requires query-engine-v2 major=2 compatibility
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should reject incompatible peer major version during compatibility check

invariants.title: Incremental range edits update stored document snapshot content
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should apply ranged incremental changes to stored query-engine document text

invariants.title: Diagnostics query responses include deterministic metadata and timing
invariants.acceptanceTest: packages/pike-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts :: should return analyzeResult for diagnostics engine queries
